title: Weather & Seasons
subject: Integrated Studies
description: Sunny, rainy, windy — what's happening in the sky?

video.title: Can You Guess the Weather? | SciShow Kids

steps: WEATHER is what the sky and air are doing right now: sunny, rainy, cloudy, windy.
In Jamaica we have a WET season (lots of rain) and a DRY season (lots of sun).
Hurricane season runs June to November — that's when we watch for big storms.
Weather tells us what to wear and do: umbrella for rain, hat and water for sun!

questions.correct: What the sky and air are doing

questions.hint: Lots of rain or lots of sun!

questions.prompt: What should you carry on a rainy day?
When is hurricane season in Jamaica?
questions.hint: We stay prepared during those months.
